title: .Net AWS Developer (REMOTE)
description:
ITTConnect is seeking a Senior .NET Developer with AWS experience to work remotely for a client in the US. This is a long term position with a client that is a global leader in consulting, digital transformation, technology and engineering services with over 300,000 team members in nearly 50 countries. The end client is in the quick serve restaurants industry.


Job location: Remote, work from home, anywhere in Brazil .


Working hours: Pacific Time Zone . You will be required to follow the client's time zone.


MUST BE fluent in English. All interviews will be in English only.


Responsibilities :

  • Design, develop and maintain scalable applications using .NET in an AWS environment, and related technologies.
  • Develop and maintain back-end applications using ASP.NET, Web APIs, etc.
  • Integrate third-party services and APIs into internal applications
  • Ensure high-quality code by writing automated tests, performing code reviews, and adhering to best practices


Requirements:

  • 10+ years of IT experience
  • Strong understanding of .NET Core and Web APIs , along with knowledge of AWS.
  • Proficient in C#, with experience building backend services (.NET framework)
  • Hands on experience in AWS environments (Azure is a plus)
  • The client expects the developer to have a very good understanding of AWS features and tools such as Lambda, SQS, SNS, EKS, Kubernetes , etc.
  • Experience supporting an integration and transformation platforms between internal systems and external vendor systems, especially those involving complex business logic.
  • Azure : Having knowledge in this area would be a bonus
  • Understanding of the QSR (fast food) industry : This is also considered a plus.
  • Good Understanding of OAuth and webhooks
  • Strong problem-solving and debugging skills
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English
  • Experience of working in a Agile environment

title: Especialista em Vendas B2B na área da Saúde
description:
Simplecheck foi fundada com a premissa de simplificar e democratizar o acesso a dados de saúde para o paciente. Nossa missão é acelerar e tornar a digitalização em saúde comercialmente viável, de modo que todo paciente tenha acesso aos seus dados de saúde, de forma segura, em qualquer lugar.

Especialista em Vendas B2B na área da Saúde

Você terá acesso a um time de talentos internacional que desenvolve tecnologias que revolucionam a jornada do paciente, e vai ajudar a ter um impacto positivo para milhões de usuários, com potencial de crescimento enorme. Estamos buscando um especialista em vendas na área da as saúde para explorar oportunidades de negócio e nos ajudar a modelar a estratégia de vendas B2B no Brasil.

O cargo requer motivação, exige um profissional que consegue navegar negócios complexos, e com aprendizado rápido.

1.       Vendas e Desenvolvimento de Negócios B2B Enterprise (80% do Tempo)

·     Identificação e Qualificação : Prospectar e qualificar ativamente contas B2B (pequenas a grandes empresas) que se encaixam no nosso Ideal Customer Profile (ICP).

·     Gestão do Ciclo de Vendas: Gerenciar todo o ciclo de vendas B2B, desde o primeiro contato até o fechamento do contrato, negociando propostas complexas e contratos de longo prazo.

·     Demonstração e Prova de Valor : Realizar demonstrações de produto convincentes, articulando claramente o ROI (Retorno sobre Investimento) e o valor da nossa solução para as necessidades específicas do cliente.

·     Metas : Alcançar e superar as metas (targets) de receita e novos negócios estabelecidas para o segmento Enterprise.

2.       Estratégia Go-to-Market (GTM) e Feedback de Produto (20% do Tempo)

·     Validação de PMF : Conduzir ou participar de entrevistas e sessões de feedback aprofundadas com prospects e clientes para identificar pain points e necessidades de mercado não atendidas.

·     Nos ajudar a determinar Unique Selling Propositions (USPs) .

·     Roadmap de Produto: Atuar como a voz do cliente Enterprise internamente, transformando o feedback coletado em requisitos de produto claros e priorizados para o time de Desenvolvimento/Produto.

·     Posicionamento: Testar e refinar continuamente nossa mensagem de GTM, proposta de valor e pricing para maximizar a conversão no mercado Enterprise.

Requisitos e Qualificações

Essenciais:

  • Experiência comprovada em Vendas B2B , preferencialmente no segmento da saúde .
  • Habilidade excepcional de comunicação , negociação e apresentação para executivos.
  • Personalidade proativa , dinâmica , que gosta de apreender e de trabalhar em ambientes complexos e desafiadores .

Diferenciais:

  • Entendimento e experiência prática em modelos SaaS, e com o conceito de Product-Market Fit (PMF) e ciclos de feedback de produto.
  • Fluência ou bom conhecimento de Inglês é recomendado
  • Conhecimento e uso prático de CRM .
  • Experiência em startups, ambientes de alta velocidade ou empresas SaaS (Software as a Service).

Se você é um talento e apaixonado por vendas, gosta de desafios e quer no futuro ter um impacto direto na saúde de milhões de pacientes, envie seu currículo e uma breve carta de apresentação mencionando como você pode contribuir para o projeto para

title: Full Stack Developer
description:
Somos mais do que um software financeiro.


A Kamino é a plataforma de gestão financeira mais completa para empresas de serviços de médio porte no Brasil . Nosso grande diferencial está em unir um software que automatiza operações financeiras (contas a pagar, contas a receber e conciliação) à integração nativa de contas bancárias e cartão corporativo de crédito, tudo em uma única plataforma. Além disso, conecta-se de forma fluida aos principais bancos e ERPs locais .


O resultado é mais eficiência, controle e visibilidade , gerando economias significativas de tempo e custos para os clientes da Kamino.


Sobre o desafio


Estamos em busca de uma pessoa Full Stack Developer para se juntar ao nosso time de tecnologia na Kamino e ajudar a construir as soluções que sustentam o crescimento dos nossos produtos.


Você busca um ambiente no qual fará parte de inovações desde o #Dia1 ?

Quer ter opções de ações e fazer parte de uma startup bem capitalizada que está pronta para acelerar?

Se a resposta for sim , continue acompanhando os requisitos que fazem sentido para essa oportunidade.


️ O que esperamos de você nesta kaminhada:


  • Estamos em busca de uma pessoa desenvolvedora para atuar no nosso time de engenharia, contribuindo com o desenvolvimento de produtos robustos, escaláveis e de alta qualidade. Aqui na Kamino, você terá liberdade e autonomia para propor soluções, colaborar com diferentes áreas e evoluir sua carreira com protagonismo.

title: Assessor de investimentos
description:
ASSESSOR DE INVESTIMENTOS (AAI) – ANCORD OBRIGATÓRIA | PROSPECÇÃO ATIVA | MODELO 100% REMOTO


Somos um escritório contratado do banco BTG Pactual, o maior banco de Investimentos da América Latina!


Somos focados em trazer proximidade e personalização de serviços, sempre visando melhor atender os objetivos financeiros dos nossos clientes.


Como parte dos nossos planos de expansão, estamos em busca de novos Assessores de Investimentos em todo o território nacional.


Nossa cultura organizacional valoriza a autonomia, o acompanhamento e a flexibilidade para os vinculados.


Oferecemos um modelo de trabalho completamente remoto, utilizando a tecnologia a nosso favor, a fim de promover agilidade, acessibilidade e qualidade de vida para todos os envolvidos em nossos planos de negócios!


Somos intrinsecamente vinculados ao campo da Educação, com parcerias importantes neste setor, a fim de promover aprimoramento crescente de nossos serviços e da carreira dos nossos associados.


Aqui você irá encontrar um ambiente leve e colaborativo, pois acreditamos que é esta a ética de trabalho que nos leva a qualidade e excelência em serviços financeiros!




Sobre o Cargo


  • Ofertar assessoria de investimentos personalizada, com foco na confiança e assertividade;
  • Oferecer serviços, estratégias e os melhores caminhos para atender as necessidades especificas de cada cliente;
  • Estar sempre atualizado sobre as tendências de mercado, a nível regional, nacional e internacional;
  • Realizar análises assertivas e contextualizadas com perfil do investidor;
  • Trabalhar com leads estratégicos e com a prospecção de clientes em potencial;
  • Tornar-se especialista no portfólio do BTG Pactual, produzindo os melhores resultados a nível pessoal e coletivo do escritório.



Requisitos


  • Possuir a certificação ANCORD ativa (indispensável);
  • Ter conhecimentos sobre Mercado Financeiro, Investimentos e desejo de se aprimorar;
  • Ter interesses e habilidades comerciais;
  • Ter interesse em prospectar potenciais investidores;
  • Desejar um modelo de trabalho remoto, alinhado com uma visão de negócios e identidade organizacional moderna e digital;
  • Motivação de crescer e alavancar ganhos!
  • Ser autônomo, movido por desafios e capaz de colaborar para objetivos comuns!
  • Possuir excelentes habilidades comunicacionais.



Modelo de Contratação


  • O assessor se vincula ao escritório no modelo de sociedade;
  • É articulado um percentual de repasses competitivo, passível de evolução e pensado de acordo com a bagagem do assessor;
  • Apoio no processo de transição de carreira e de entrada no mercado, contanto com acompanhamento próximo e valor de suporte (mínimo garantido mensal) com duração de 6 meses.



Etapas de Seleção


  • Entrevista com Sócios;
  • Processo de Compliance.

title: Content Writer (Portuguese) - 53457
description:
About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L.


Role Overview:

We are looking for a detail-oriented Content Writer to create and refine content used in workflows, training data, and scenario-based evaluations for large language models (LLMs). You will help build realistic content samples, review AI-generated outputs, and ensure accuracy, clarity, and consistency.


What does day-to-day look like:

  • Create and edit content across formats such as articles, guides, workflows, and scenarios.
  • Recreate real-world content workflows for AI evaluation.
  • Review AI outputs for quality, accuracy, and adherence to guidelines.
  • Provide feedback and annotations to support LLM improvement.
  • Collaborate with product and AI teams to align content with operational needs.


Required Qualifications:

  • 2+ years experience as a Content Writer, Copywriter, or Technical Writer.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to identify content gaps or inconsistencies.
  • Familiarity with documentation or workflow tools (e.g., Confluence, Notion, Zendesk, Jira).
  • Excellent written communication skills.


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Work in a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required : at least 4 hours per day and minimum 40 hours per week with 4 hours of overlap with PST.
  • Engagement type : Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave)
  • Duration of contract : 1 month


Evaluation Process :

  • Shortlisted candidates will be reviewed by our team internally and shortlisted candidates will be reached out for onboarding.

title: Coordenador Operações Transporte
description:
Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Contribuir com a manutenção de estoques de produtos nos níveis desejados, bem como, no recebimento de cargas de produtos, orientando na conferência, descarregamento e organização dos produtos no galpão;
  • Contribuir nos trabalhos de classificação e separação de garrafas para envasamento, garantindo controle através do envio da planilha para conhecimento e análise do responsável pelo Regional Operacional no fechamento do mês; Assegurar o controle dos comodatos com giro e sem giro de compras;
  • Acompanhar rota com a equipe de distribuição avaliando postura, uso de EPI, dirigibilidade, rota, sequenciamento e com o vendedor, itens comodatados e cadastros para controles e proposições de melhorias no processo;
  • Contribuir com a eficiência operacional e a rentabilidade do negócio, por meio de análise dos indicadores de desempenho da logística (Despesas-HL, Devolução, Horas extras, nº de entregas, etc) através do portal de indicadores logísticos da empresa e conferências físicas x contábeis, visando atender as metas estabelecidas e buscar ações para melhorias contínuas.


Requisitos:

  • Graduação completa em: Administração de Empresas, logística ou áreas correlatas.
  • Pacote office Intermediário ao avançado;
  • Experiência com Gestão de Pessoas e Gestão em processos Logísticos;
  • Indispensável o conhecimento em distribuição no segmento de bens de consumo na cidade de Salvador/BA.


Benefícios:

  • Assistência médica e odontológica estendida a dependentes;
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Vale-alimentação;
  • Vale-refeição;
  • Wellhub;
  • Programas de saúde e bem-estar.

Work Model

The candidate can work remotely and must be available to be contacted via Microsoft Teams for any meetings during European business hours.

title: Data Research Analyst
description:
REQUIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

  • 3-5 years of data analysis and reporting experience
  • Advanced experience writing and creating large-scale surveys (QuestionPro, Qualtrics), analyzing results/data, and developing actionable findings
  • Experience with Tableau for data visualization
  • Experience in writing detailed reports and presenting data findings/analysis.

NICE TO HAVE SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

  • Passion for video games/gaming in order to assist in writing and interpreting survey questions
  • Experience with SQL writing data queries
  • Snowflake or Data Bricks experience


Insight Global is hiring a Data Research Analyst to support the User Experience Research team at a leading company in the Gaming industry. The main role of the Data Research Analyst will be to create, send, and analyze large-scale surveys intended to learn about the player base of the core gaming products.

Job Functions

-Create surveys and trackers to support all products and initiatives

  • Design questions that do not bias respondents
  • Use best practice methodologies to produce actionable, accurate, and representative data.

-Advanced, survey focused, data visualizations (Tableau, Excel, Sheets)

  • Creating clear reports and dashboards based on surveys sent to players and users of their products.

-Data queries (HIVE, Snowflake, Tableau)

  • Querying multiple types of databases and plugging data queries directly into tools like Tableau are essential for this role. These skills will be used to target audiences for survey sends, pull in additional analytics to identify respondents, and allow for advanced data visualizations.

-Report writing and presenting data

  • Writing detailed and understandable reports that will speak to a variety of audiences across the enterprise
  • Presenting data in meetings and providing additional relevant context where applicable.

-Act as backup for all functions of current data researchers

-Provide support to UX researchers on report creation that involves data visualization.

-Quickly pivot with new data to ensure a constant flow of player insights are output as updated player survey data is received to ensure we are always reporting on timely and relevant findings.

-Contribute to overall needs of the UXR team e.g. peer review, supporting other teams with survey expertise, etc.

-Contribute survey expertise to assist others in the company with the creation of surveys.

title: Network Operations Center Technician
description:
Required Skills & Experience


  • 5 years experience troubleshooting DWDM Networks
  • 3 years experience with Ciena 6500 /Infinera/Alcatel PSS-32/16 required
  • 3 years experience in a network operations role required.


Nice to Have Skills & Experience


  • Experience working in the field as a Fiber Technician


Job Description


A large telecommunications company is looking for a candidate that will be responsible for maintaining the stability and reliability of network services through advanced technical expertise and proactive coordination. The role includes performing complex troubleshooting and diagnostics, creating and deploying maintenance requests for after-hours network augments, and collaborating with the Network Control Center, Technical Assistance Center, and external vendors to ensure the health of priority circuits. Key duties involve monitoring network operations, conducting remote and off-net testing, managing escalations, and coordinating repair activities by dispatching field technicians and providing timely updates to customers. The position also requires gathering and analyzing network data, creating and executing scripts for repetitive tasks, and identifying automation opportunities to improve operational efficiency.

title: Front-End & UI/UX Designer (Webflow + WordPress)
description:
Hey, Dingus!


Yep—you read that right. Dingus & Zazzy is expanding, and we’re on the hunt for a versatile, design-driven Webflow + WordPress expert who can take a website from concept to completion.


About Us


Dingus & Zazzy is a global digital marketing agency helping brands grow across every corner of the digital landscape. We offer an “unlimited get-shit-done” subscription for our clients—from websites to social to SEO and everything in between.

Our team is full of creatives, strategists, tech geeks, and builders who love making brands look, feel, and perform better online. If that sounds like your vibe, keep reading.



What You’ll Do


  • Design and develop responsive, visually engaging websites in Webflow and WordPress .
  • Create wireframes, prototypes, and full website designs that align with user needs and client goals.
  • Translate approved designs into fully-built, functional websites using Webflow or WordPress.
  • Collaborate with internal teams to clarify requirements and ensure flawless execution.
  • Ensure all designs follow UX/UI best practices , accessibility standards, and performance guidelines.
  • Customize, refine, and optimize websites based on client feedback.
  • Stay up-to-date with digital design trends, tools, and new Webflow/WordPress capabilities.
  • Troubleshoot design-related issues and ensure smooth handoff and deployment.


What You Bring


  • 3+ years of professional experience designing AND developing websites using Webflow and WordPress .
  • A strong portfolio showcasing web design, UX/UI work, prototypes, and completed builds .
  • Proficiency in wireframing tools and design platforms (Figma, XD, Sketch, etc.).
  • Solid understanding of HTML, CSS , and responsive design principles.
  • Experience with site performance optimization and SEO-friendly design practices.
  • Ability to work effectively within a fully remote team.
  • Strong communication skills—you can articulate design decisions clearly.
  • Close attention to detail and a passion for creating elevated digital experiences.



Bonus Points


  • Experience with animations or micro-interactions in Webflow.
  • Familiarity with brand identity or graphic design.
  • Experience working in fast-paced agency settings.



Work Details


  • Hours: 9 A.M. – 5 P.M. MST , Monday to Friday
  • Requires a working level of written and spoken English


If you’re someone who can dream up a beautiful interface, bring it to life, and polish it until it shines, we want to hear from you.


Ready for the ride of your life? Apply now!

title: Senior Data Scientist
description:
Quem Somos


A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 60 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de soluções de staffing, soluções de TI e complementação de força de trabalho. Estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, projetos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação. Apoiamos nossos clientes para encontrar a melhor maneira que seu gap de talentos seja endereçado, de maneira a suportar seu processo de transformação digital. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.

O que esperar de nós


Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. A Dexian está comprometida com a responsabilidade social corporativa e, investe em programas que apoiam a diversidade e inclusão.

Se você compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar!

O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho


  • Projetar, construir e implantar modelos de analytics preditivos e prescritivos para apoiar a tomada de decisão baseada em dados em operações.
  • Aplicar técnicas avançadas de modelagem, como previsão, otimização e classificação, para resolver problemas operacionais complexos.
  • Contribuir para o desenvolvimento de ferramentas de automação inteligente, testando aplicações de GenAI que melhorem comunicação, visibilidade e responsividade.
  • Colaborar de perto com engenheiros de dados, analistas e parceiros de negócios para garantir qualidade dos dados e implementação escalável das soluções de analytics.


O que você precisa ter


  • Forte proficiência em Python, SQL e ambientes de dados em nuvem (AWS, GCP ou Azure).
  • Experiência prática com frameworks de machine learning (scikit-learn, TensorFlow, PyTorch) e ferramentas de visualização de dados (Power BI, Tableau).
  • Capacidade comprovada de aplicar analytics em áreas operacionais como supply chain, sourcing ou planejamento.
  • Familiaridade ou interesse em aplicações de IA Generativa e LLMs em contextos de negócio.
  • Excelentes habilidades de resolução de problemas, comunicação e storytelling — capaz de conectar insights de dados ao impacto estratégico.
  • Inglês avançado para conversação.

Onde você vai trabalhar


No conforto da sua casa, regime 100% remoto!

Experiência em atividades relacionadas à atuação em atendimento médico em Endocrinologia , sendo desejável experiência prévia em Telemedicina e Atenção Primária à Saúde;

Prestar orientações personalizadas a indivíduos e suas famílias com conhecimentos para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios Endócrinos e metabólicos..


Competências Comportamentais:

Comprometimento com os pacientes, com ideais e valores da empresa, apresentando postura ética, pontualidade, capacidade de integração com equipe multiprofissional.


Outros Requisitos Importantes:

Conhecimentos e Habilidades em computação: uso do Pacote Office (Excel, Word, Power Point, Gráficos) e Internet. Familiaridade com tecnologias de telemedicina e uso de plataformas de comunicação virtual é um diferencial desejável.

REMOTO

title: Senior Java Technical Lead (AI-Augmented Development)
description:
QAT Global , a US-based IT consulting firm with over 30 years of experience, is seeking a highly skilled Senior Java Technical Lead to join our global engineering team. We deliver world-class technology solutions to clients across the US, Costa Rica, and Brazil, with a strong culture of engineering excellence and innovation.


This is a full-time, 100% remote position (CLT hire in Brazil only), offering the opportunity to work directly with our US-based customer while collaborating with cross-functional, distributed teams. Advanced English proficiency is mandatory, as you will communicate daily with US stakeholders.


About the Role


As a Senior Java Technical Lead , you will be responsible for leading all technical decision-making across backend and frontend development, ensuring architectural consistency, engineering best practices, and high-quality code delivery.

This role requires an expert-level Java professional who has begun integrating AI-assisted development workflows , including LLMs such as GPT and Claude, into their software engineering practices.


You will lead full-stack developers, collaborate closely with Solution Architects, BAs, DevOps, and AI Engineers, and oversee complex business domains such as Billing, Ledger, Invoice, and Remittance .

If you are a seasoned Java engineer who is also evolving into the new era of AI-enhanced software development, this role is for you.


Responsibilities


  • Lead all technical decision-making across backend and frontend architecture.
  • Ensure code quality, engineering best practices, and architectural coherence.
  • Guide full-stack developers implementing backend services and UI components.
  • Collaborate with Solution Architect, BA, DevOps, and AI Engineer to translate requirements into scalable, secure solutions.
  • Oversee complex financial and operational domains (Billing, Ledger, Invoice, Remittance).
  • Design, supervise, and optimize workflows that leverage LLMs for code generation, review, and refactoring.
  • Provide technical leadership on when and how to use AI tools safely and effectively.


Required Qualifications


Core Engineering Skills:


  • Senior-level Java/Spring Boot experience (expert level required).
  • Strong experience with Node.js , React , and Postgres .
  • Experience with Security, DevOps, Cloud , and GitHub ecosystem.
  • GitHub Advanced Security, GitHub CI/CD pipelines, and versioning best practices.


Cloud & Infrastructure:

  • Strong experience with AWS Identity Management .
  • Hands-on expertise with AWS workloads: EC2, RDS, SQS .


AI & LLM Experience (Required):


  • Solid understanding of LLMs and its capabilities.
  • Experience with Claude Sonnet 4.5 or similar models for:
  • Code generation
  • Code review
  • Code refactoring
  • Proficiency in prompt engineering , including:
  • Structured prompting
  • Chain-of-thought patterns
  • Constraints-driven prompting
  • Code-oriented prompting
  • Ability to guide developers on the safe, effective use of AI tools in daily engineering work.


Preferred Qualifications (Nice to Have)


  • BS/MS in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related technical fields.
  • Experience leading distributed development teams.
  • Familiarity with modern architectural patterns and enterprise-level systems.

title: Profissional  FullStack NODEJS | .Net | Angular
description:
BRQ WAY

No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!

É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.

Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.


Ei Profissional venha fazer parte de uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país!



  • O que procuramos?

Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!


  • O que você deve ter?
  • Experiência sólida com Node.js e desenvolvimento de APIs
  • Domínio de .NET (C#) e ASP.NET Core
  • Conhecimento avançado em Angular (preferencialmente versões 20+)
  • Experiência com PostgreSQL
  • Conhecimento em MongoDB e/ou DocumentDB
  • Versionamento com Git
  • Conhecimento em TypeScript
  • Inglês intermediário

⭐ Requisitos Desejáveis

  • Experiência com NestJS
  • Arquitetura de microserviços
  • Arquitetura de microfrontend
  • Familiaridade com Docker
  • Experiência com cloud (AWS, Azure ou GCP)
  • Ferramentas de CI/CD
  • RxJS e programação reativa
  • Testes unitários e de integração (Jest, xUnit)
  • Conhecimento em design patterns

Diferenciais

  • Conhecimento em mensageria (RabbitMQ, Kafka, SQS )
  • Familiaridade com práticas DevOps


O que temos pra te oferecer?

Mais do que um plano de carreira!

A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 etapas:

- Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!

- Mobilidade Interna: Você quer um novo rumo profissional? Aqui dentro de casa temos diversas opções diferentes e o programa de mobilidade interna, que te permite mudar de área, por exemplo.

- Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.

- Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.

E os benefícios?


Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Home Office; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!


Como é trabalhar na BRQ?


Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions

Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

title: Senior Full Stack Web Application Developer
description:
We are looking for a full-time remote Senior Full-Stack Web Application Developer with 7+ years of experience producing commercial-grade software that is highly maintainable and supportable. The ideal candidate will be highly adept at working in a vibrant, dynamic startup environment with a small team, have proven on-time delivery experience, strong problem-solving abilities, an aptitude for learning new technologies and concepts quickly, and be trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent.

Our industry-leading client provides cloud-based business automation software for over 2000 independent upstream and midstream oil & gas companies in North America. The company's solutions manage land, production, accounting, and transportation for E&P operators, crude oil purchasers, transporters, haulers, investors, and accounting firms. Their customers benefit from the automation of the most complex business processes, reducing operating costs, saving time, and increasing profitability through reporting, analytics, and decision-support systems once exclusive to major integrated oil companies.


Responsibilities:

  • Maintain and enhance legacy application - JavaScript frontend and PHP backend running on Linux, nginx (engine x), fpm, and mostly MySQL
  • Modernize software solution using React.js and/or Vue.js design, architect, develop, deliver, and sustain
  • Take technical ownership of features and their impact on the business - assist with refining functional and technical specifications
  • Deliver product features and updates with minimal direction, yet know when to seek help to remain efficient
  • Review and approve pull requests from less senior developers and assure alignment with established best practices
  • Build and execute unit tests
  • Interact with end-users/customers to ensure smooth deployments and to understand needs/issues
  • Address defects identified during various testing cycles
  • Participate in daily standups and weekly team meetings to review priorities, progress, new ideas, and technologies
  • Display comprehensive understanding of the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC), as applied to projects of increasing size and complexity, with emphasis on:
  • Problem solving
  • Critical thinking
  • Analysis and design
  • Estimating
  • Planning



REQUIRED (Must Have):

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 7+ years of full-stack software engineering experience
  • 4+ years of experience using JavaScript, PHP, and Linux
  • Passion for whole product delivery and exceptional customer experiences, must have experience considering architectural side-effects, edge-cases, backward compatibility, integrations, and internal/external team/customer enablement
  • Experience building, delivering, and sustaining production, commercial-quality, n-tiered software architecture web-based applications
  • Prior success as a senior developer coaching less skilled/experienced developers, establishing coding guidelines/best practices, and reviewing pull requests
  • Familiarity with varied data capture, normalization/transformation, and storage/management that enable high-performance data querying for reporting
  • Experience working with Agile and other development methodologies
  • Ability to work independently yet know when to seek assistance to ensure deadlines are met with high quality
  • Team player with practical communication skills and collaborative approach
  • Strong problem-solving abilities as well as aptitude to learn new technologies and concepts quickly
  • Flexibility and openness to new ideas or change, with the passion and drive to excel in their career
  • Self-motivated, results-oriented, creative, and accountable


PREFERRED (But NOT Required):

  • University degree or equivalent education (a technical or engineering degree is optimal)
  • Familiar with nginx web server (aka "Engine X")
  • Experience with React.js or Vue.js
  • Familiarity with the upstream and midstream oil/gas industry


What YOU Get!

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter - Think Big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP

title: Customer Support Representative, Level 1
description:
JoVE is the world- leading producer and provider of video solutions with the mission to improve scientific research and education. Millions of scientists, educators and students use JoVE for their research, teaching and learning. Our institutional clients comprise over 1,000 universities, colleges, and biopharma companies, including such leaders as Harvard, MIT, Yale, and Stanford. As a rapidly growing company, with offices in the USA, UK, Australia, and India servicing clients in over 60 countries, we are seeking talented and ambitious individuals to join our company.


The Role


We are seeking an experienced Customer Support Representative to be on the front lines by answering questions and troubleshooting technical problems. You will assist customers with JoVE’s products and also guide clients through any technical issue they might encounter. If you are an energetic self-starter problem solver with a basic technical background and excellent communication skills, we want to talk to you. The Support Team here at JoVE is providing support not only to external customers but also to internal JoVE employees on a 24x7 basis.



Responsibilities:


  • Manage large amounts of incoming tickets.
  • Provide support to answer inquiries on products.
  • Accept and handle technical requests.
  • Triage tickets to the correct L2 teams.
  • Follow communication procedures, guidelines and policies.
  • Provide accurate, valid and complete information by using the right methods/tools.
  • Build sustainable relationships and trust with customers through open communication.
  • Handle customer complaints, provide appropriate solutions and alternatives within the time limits; follow up to ensure resolution.
  • Keep records of customer interactions, process customer accounts and file documents.
  • Take the extra mile to engage customers.
  • Performs other specific duties or assignments as directed by Team Manager.


Skills And Qualifications:


  • A Bachelor’s in Computer Science or related field.
  • 2+ years of demonstrable experience in customer support.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, verbal and written, are required to effectively and accurately communicate in English.
  • Ability to communicate with both technical and non-technical personnel in a clear and easy fashion.
  • Basic understanding of KPIs and Metrics.
  • Attention to detail is key to this position.
  • Must be able to accommodate flexible work schedules based on business needs.
  • Must have technical/diagnostic ability along with analytical ability to diagnose problems above basics, and basic mechanical skills.
  • Understand how to use a web browser console log in the debugging process
  • Understanding of Public/Priviate IP addresses and Domain names
  • Understanding what a Firewall does
  • What does a Proxy Server do
  • Understanding of the basics of SSO


Why Join JoVE?


  • A competitive compensation package.
  • You will make a direct impact in accelerating science research and education.
  • Opportunity to work with global teams and in an environment that promotes innovation and collaboration.
  • Our strong promotion from within culture draws a clear path to advance your career with us

title: Representante de Vendas
description:
About Refer

Refer is an exclusive AI-powered career agent that connects top talent from Stanford, MIT, Harvard, and other top 20 US universities to leading tech companies like NVIDIA, Meta, Glean, DeepMind, Scale AI, and 1,000+ startups.


We are expanding rapidly and launching a Refer & Earn program so more people can help us grow this elite talent community — and get rewarded for it.


✨ About the Role

We’re looking for Sales Representatives who want a flexible, remote opportunity to help talented people find great jobs — and get paid extremely well for it.


This is not a typical “marketing” or “recruiting” job.


Your role is simple:

Share Refer with people who qualify

When they join and get accepted — you earn

If they get hired — you earn big

That's it.


Compensation (Commission Only)

You earn:

  • $50 for every qualified user you bring who signs up
  • $1,000 if they get hired or make a hire through Refer

There is no limit to how much you can earn.

Some ambassadors make a few hundred dollars per week.

Some make thousands.


Who Should Apply

This role is perfect for people who:

  • Are active on LinkedIn
  • Have friends from top universities
  • Know people in tech or startups
  • Are involved in online communities
  • Want a flexible side gig with high upside
  • Want to help people find jobs that match their potential

No experience required.

Just bring people to Refer — we do the rest.


Who Qualifies to Be Referred

You’ll have the most success referring people who are:

  • Job seekers with a degree from a top 20 US university , OR
  • Hiring managers / team leads at top tech companies or startups
  • US-based only

You’ll receive more details and tools after joining.


What You’ll Do

As a Sales Representative, you will:

  • Promote Refer
  • Post about Refer in relevant online communities
  • Invite top talent and hiring managers to join
  • Use your unique invitation link to track earnings
  • Help us grow the strongest talent network in the country

We’ll provide:

  • Messaging templates
  • Guidance on where to promote
  • Best practices to maximize your earnings

title: Senior Full Stack Developer (React.js / Python)
description:
We are seeking a full-time, remote Senior Full Stack Developer with 4+ years of full-stack experience primarily focused on React.js front-end development. You will join our clients' innovative, growing team on a mission to unleash the power of culture for growing organizational brands at a time of global, seismic cultural transformation.

You will participate in the complete software development process from conception to deployment of our clients ' world-class data and insights platform. You will work closely with product and UX leads, providing a critical voice in solutioning complex workflows and user experiences.

If you are a self-starter who enjoys a fast-paced, dynamic, and autonomous environment and thrives in challenging situations, then you are the right person for the job. The ideal candidate must collaborate well within a team, leverage strong technological expertise, and adeptly analyze and prioritize features and requirements. You will build upon our clients' next-generation front-end user experience, connecting it to and enhancing the backend data pipeline.

Our client unleashes the power of culture to drive brand growth through consumer insights, analytics, tools, and best practices for over 250 major U.S. brands. Its solutions are powered by its cultural intelligence platform, which enables its customers to understand, reach, and engage consumers more effectively and efficiently, activating them across race, ethnicity, generation, gender, and sexual identity.

Our client comprises creative, analytical, diverse, hardworking, and fun individuals with an insatiable curiosity for the new collage of behaviors and patterns driving consumers today. The possibilities of the moment and opportunity to help organizations unlock their cultural capacity inspire them to seek out predictive insights and brand impacts that are unique to their model.


Responsibilities

  • Work with development teams and product managers to ideate software solutions
  • Architect and build application front-ends with appealing visual design
  • Develop functional, scalable applications
  • Write effective APIs
  • Test software to ensure responsiveness and efficiency
  • Troubleshoot, debug, and upgrade software
  • Create security and data protection settings
  • Build features and applications with a mobile-responsive design
  • Write technical documentation
  • Work with data scientists and analysts to improve AI/ML-based software


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication and teamwork skills
  • 4+ years of full-stack development experience primarily using React.js in the front-end
  • Knowledge of additional front-end languages and libraries (e.g., HTML / CSS, JavaScript, XML, and jQuery)
  • 2+ years working in AWS (preferred), GCP, Azure, or other cloud platform
  • 1+ years of Python experience
  • Familiarity with databases (e.g., MySQL and MongoDB), web servers (e.g., Apache), and UI/UX design
  • Great attention to detail, strong organizational skills, and an analytical mind
  • Proven delivery experience in a vibrant, dynamic startup environment
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently or within a broader team
  • Track record of building professional, high-quality, and on-time software
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent


Preferred Experience

  • University degree in computer science, statistics, or a relevant field
  • Experience with DataViz
  • Experience with Snowflake, Flask, Django, or FastAPI


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued team members on client teams. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: .Net AWS Developer (REMOTE)
description:
ITTConnect is seeking a Senior .NET Developer with AWS experience to work remotely for a client in the US. This is a long term position with a client that is a global leader in consulting, digital transformation, technology and engineering services with over 300,000 team members in nearly 50 countries. The end client is in the quick serve restaurants industry.


Job location: Remote, work from home, anywhere in Brazil .


Working hours: Pacific Time Zone . You will be required to follow the client's time zone.


MUST BE fluent in English. All interviews will be in English only.


Responsibilities :

  • Design, develop and maintain scalable applications using .NET in an AWS environment, and related technologies.
  • Develop and maintain back-end applications using ASP.NET, Web APIs, etc.
  • Integrate third-party services and APIs into internal applications
  • Ensure high-quality code by writing automated tests, performing code reviews, and adhering to best practices


Requirements:

  • 10+ years of IT experience
  • Strong understanding of .NET Core and Web APIs , along with knowledge of AWS.
  • Proficient in C#, with experience building backend services (.NET framework)

  • Good Understanding of OAuth and webhooks
  • Strong problem-solving and debugging skills
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English
  • Experience of working in a Agile environment

title: Golang Developer - Relocation to Spain
description:
At CAPITOLE, we keep growing and want to do it with you!


We’re looking for passionate Backend Engineers with at least 3 years of experience in Golang to join our team and take part in a high-impact international project for a top-tier global brand. You’ll work in a modern, collaborative environment where innovation, performance, and scalability are at the heart of everything we build.

  • Hands-on experience with Domain-Driven Design (DDD) and Test-Driven Development (TDD).
  • A high level of English is required since you will be working with international teams, and English is the working language.

title: Staff Software Engineer
description:
Position : Staff Software Engineer

Location: Remote - working EST time zone

Duration: 12-month contract + extensions


About the Role:

We are seeking a Staff Engineer to provide technical leadership and mentorship to our engineering team. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience in Java development, including Spring Boot and Microservices architecture, and a proven track record of building robust, efficient solutions with PIM and Event Streaming experience. This role requires a strong technical foundation, leadership capabilities, a passion for innovation, and the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams and manage stakeholder relationships to deliver high-quality software. This is an individual contributor role - but will be providing technical leadership in terms of strategy, mentorship, etc.


Requirements:

  • 5+ years of experience as a Senior Engineer
  • 9+ years of experience in Java development and working in Spring Boot frameworks.
  • 1-2+ years of experience working a retail environment
  • Experience working with PIM platforms
  • Experience building Microservices using Spring frameworks and deploying to cloud environments such as GCP/AWS/Azure in an agile environment.
  • Hands-on experience in API development such as RESTFUL/ SOAP web services.
  • Working knowledge of database and storage such as Oracle, Postgresql, MongoDB, or Redis, etc.
  • Experience in event driven/message-oriented middleware such as IBM MQ, Kafka, RabbitMQ etc.
  • Demonstrated ability in building and leading technical teams, with or without direct reports.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, capable of working in a developer-centric, startup-like environment.


Nice to Have Skills:

  • Experience in leading engineering projects and integrating PIM platforms such as Akeneo.

title: Content Writer (Portuguese) - 53457
description:
About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L.


Role Overview:

We are looking for a detail-oriented Content Writer to create and refine content used in workflows, training data, and scenario-based evaluations for large language models (LLMs). You will help build realistic content samples, review AI-generated outputs, and ensure accuracy, clarity, and consistency.


What does day-to-day look like:

  • Create and edit content across formats such as articles, guides, workflows, and scenarios.
  • Recreate real-world content workflows for AI evaluation.
  • Review AI outputs for quality, accuracy, and adherence to guidelines.
  • Provide feedback and annotations to support LLM improvement.
  • Collaborate with product and AI teams to align content with operational needs.


Required Qualifications:

  • 2+ years experience as a Content Writer, Copywriter, or Technical Writer.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to identify content gaps or inconsistencies.
  • Familiarity with documentation or workflow tools (e.g., Confluence, Notion, Zendesk, Jira).
  • Excellent written communication skills.


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Work in a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required : at least 4 hours per day and minimum 40 hours per week with 4 hours of overlap with PST.
  • Engagement type : Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave)
  • Duration of contract : 1 month


Evaluation Process :

  • Shortlisted candidates will be reviewed by our team internally and shortlisted candidates will be reached out for onboarding.

title: Assessor de investimentos
description:
ASSESSOR DE INVESTIMENTOS (AAI) – ANCORD OBRIGATÓRIA | PROSPECÇÃO ATIVA | MODELO 100% REMOTO


Somos um escritório contratado do banco BTG Pactual, o maior banco de Investimentos da América Latina!


Somos focados em trazer proximidade e personalização de serviços, sempre visando melhor atender os objetivos financeiros dos nossos clientes.


Como parte dos nossos planos de expansão, estamos em busca de novos Assessores de Investimentos em todo o território nacional.


Nossa cultura organizacional valoriza a autonomia, o acompanhamento e a flexibilidade para os vinculados.


Oferecemos um modelo de trabalho completamente remoto, utilizando a tecnologia a nosso favor, a fim de promover agilidade, acessibilidade e qualidade de vida para todos os envolvidos em nossos planos de negócios!


Somos intrinsecamente vinculados ao campo da Educação, com parcerias importantes neste setor, a fim de promover aprimoramento crescente de nossos serviços e da carreira dos nossos associados.


Aqui você irá encontrar um ambiente leve e colaborativo, pois acreditamos que é esta a ética de trabalho que nos leva a qualidade e excelência em serviços financeiros!




Sobre o Cargo


  • Ofertar assessoria de investimentos personalizada, com foco na confiança e assertividade;
  • Oferecer serviços, estratégias e os melhores caminhos para atender as necessidades especificas de cada cliente;
  • Estar sempre atualizado sobre as tendências de mercado, a nível regional, nacional e internacional;
  • Realizar análises assertivas e contextualizadas com perfil do investidor;
  • Trabalhar com leads estratégicos e com a prospecção de clientes em potencial;
  • Tornar-se especialista no portfólio do BTG Pactual, produzindo os melhores resultados a nível pessoal e coletivo do escritório.



Requisitos


  • Possuir a certificação ANCORD ativa (indispensável);
  • Ter conhecimentos sobre Mercado Financeiro, Investimentos e desejo de se aprimorar;
  • Ter interesses e habilidades comerciais;
  • Ter interesse em prospectar potenciais investidores;
  • Desejar um modelo de trabalho remoto, alinhado com uma visão de negócios e identidade organizacional moderna e digital;
  • Motivação de crescer e alavancar ganhos!
  • Ser autônomo, movido por desafios e capaz de colaborar para objetivos comuns!
  • Possuir excelentes habilidades comunicacionais.



Modelo de Contratação


  • O assessor se vincula ao escritório no modelo de sociedade;
  • É articulado um percentual de repasses competitivo, passível de evolução e pensado de acordo com a bagagem do assessor;
  • Apoio no processo de transição de carreira e de entrada no mercado, contanto com acompanhamento próximo e valor de suporte (mínimo garantido mensal) com duração de 6 meses.



Etapas de Seleção

  • Processo de Compliance.

title: UI Designer
description:
A STEP é uma empresa de engenharia especializada no setor automotivo, reconhecida por sua excelência técnica e compromisso com a inovação. Fundada em 1992, a empresa estabeleceu sua sede em Turim, cidade considerada o centro do desenvolvimento automotivo na Itália.

Com o objetivo de expandir sua atuação e atender melhor às demandas regionais, a STEP inaugurou em 2004 a unidade Step do Sul , localizada em Pomigliano, na província de Nápoles.

Em 2009, dando continuidade ao seu plano de internacionalização, a empresa investiu na América Latina, o que resultou na abertura de uma Sede também em Contagem (Minas Gerais, Brasil) , ampliando sua presença no mercado global.



UI Design


Deliverables


Creation of innovative UI Design solutions to satisfy customer requests.

Creation of emotional presentation in order to explain the conceptual ideations and development of the project.


Management of the research phase:

  • Analysis and constant updating of technologies and design trends in present and future use;
  • Analysis of the current market in the context of the current project;
  • Mood board creations;
  • Management of the research phase and evaluation of customer requests and user requirements;
  • Participation in brainstorming sessions and workshops with the team;
  • Definition of the graphic concept.


Management of the design phase:

  • Create innovative graphic interfaces to satisfy customer requests; Development of a style guide and documentation to support the technical team;
  • Create 2D/3D assets, icons, color definitions and other graphic elements for prototyping and final production of the project.


Management of the development phase:

  • Presentation of proposals to customers;
  • Perfecting of the proposal chosen by the customer to meet their needs and suggest any improvements;
  • Collaboration with other Departments to integrate interdisciplinary technical aspects (CAS Department, Feasibility, Electric/Electronics).



General requirements

Following competence with high level of experience in the team are required:


  • Fluent English is MANDATORY because it is the official language of the project.
  • NICE TO HAVE Italian language.
  • Experience in Automotive Fields.
  • Knowledge of the needs of different types of users and ability to intercept those needs.
  • Analysis and benchmarking skills.
  • Identification of the technology that can at best intercept and satisfy customer requests with those offered by the reference market.
  • Ability to create emotional, engaging and convincing presentations towards customers (eg. mood board creation).
  • Ability to intercept the best solution in order to satisfy customer requests.
  • Deepened knowledge of Software in particular Photoshop, Illustrator, Figma, After Effects, Blender as well as Microsoft Office package (PPT, Word, Excel, Outlook).
  • Customer orientation and ability to speak in public and facing the client.
  • Team work ability and empathy



Work Model

The candidate can work remotely and must be available to be contacted via Microsoft Teams for any meetings during European business hours.

title: Customer Support & Revenue Operations Specialist
description:
Position Summary

We are looking for a Customer Support & Revenue Operations Specialist to join a fast-growing real estate startup in the U.S. This is a hybrid role that combines helpdesk support, HubSpot operations, outbound sales assistance, and light marketing support.

The ideal candidate has strong experience managing support tickets, excellent communication skills, deep familiarity with HubSpot, and the ability to multitask across customer support, RevOps, and sales processes in a fast-paced startup environment.


Key Responsibilities

Customer Support & Helpdesk (40–50%)

  • Serve as the primary responder for inbound support tickets from users.
  • Monitor, triage, and resolve issues through HubSpot Service Hub.
  • Maintain strong response/resolution times with empathetic, professional communication.
  • Document common issues and build internal resources or playbooks.


HubSpot Operations & Administration (20–25%)

  • Manage and optimize workflows, pipelines, automations, and ticket management across HubSpot.
  • Maintain data accuracy for contacts, deals, and support tickets.
  • Support setup and QA of new sequences, processes, and automation in HubSpot.
  • Pull basic reports on sales activity, ticket volume, and marketing performance.


Outbound Sales & Appointment Setting (20–25%)

  • Execute outbound email campaigns and sequences targeting prospects such as real estate agents or brokers.
  • Qualify inbound and outbound leads following defined playbooks.
  • Set calls and demos for the sales team.
  • Track all activities and updates inside HubSpot.


Marketing Support (5–10%)

  • Assist with email marketing campaigns, list building, and segmentation.
  • Support basic digital marketing tasks as needed.


Required Qualifications

  • 2+ years of customer support or helpdesk experience (B2B SaaS experience preferred).
  • Hands-on experience with HubSpot, including:
  • Service/Operations Hub (tickets, workflows, automation)
  • Sales Hub (pipelines, deals, sequences, tasks)
  • Proven success managing support tickets as a core responsibility.
  • Experience supporting outbound sales workflows, sequences, and appointment setting.
  • Familiarity with email marketing or digital campaign support.
  • Excellent English communication skills (written and verbal).
  • Highly organized, detail-oriented, and able to manage multiple priorities.
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced startup environment with shifting demands.
  • Availability to work 9:00 AM – 5:30 PM MST .


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in real estate or PropTech industries.
  • Familiarity with Google Workspace, ClickUp, and Canva.
  • Experience building support documentation, macros, or knowledge base articles.
  • Track record of improving support metrics or boosting outbound meeting conversions.


What We Offer

  • Fully Remote Position! Work from anywhere in the world.
  • Professional Growth: Opportunities for career advancement and skill development.
  • Take Your Local Holidays: We respect your cultural and personal commitments.
  • Impact: Join a mission-driven U.S. startup where your work directly enhances customer experience and revenue operations.
  • Compensation: Competitive salary and performance-based incentives.

title: Especialista em Vendas B2B na área da Saúde
description:
Simplecheck foi fundada com a premissa de simplificar e democratizar o acesso a dados de saúde para o paciente. Nossa missão é acelerar e tornar a digitalização em saúde comercialmente viável, de modo que todo paciente tenha acesso aos seus dados de saúde, de forma segura, em qualquer lugar.

Especialista em Vendas B2B na área da Saúde

Você terá acesso a um time de talentos internacional que desenvolve tecnologias que revolucionam a jornada do paciente, e vai ajudar a ter um impacto positivo para milhões de usuários, com potencial de crescimento enorme. Estamos buscando um especialista em vendas na área da as saúde para explorar oportunidades de negócio e nos ajudar a modelar a estratégia de vendas B2B no Brasil.

O cargo requer motivação, exige um profissional que consegue navegar negócios complexos, e com aprendizado rápido.

1.       Vendas e Desenvolvimento de Negócios B2B Enterprise (80% do Tempo)

·     Identificação e Qualificação : Prospectar e qualificar ativamente contas B2B (pequenas a grandes empresas) que se encaixam no nosso Ideal Customer Profile (ICP).

·     Gestão do Ciclo de Vendas: Gerenciar todo o ciclo de vendas B2B, desde o primeiro contato até o fechamento do contrato, negociando propostas complexas e contratos de longo prazo.

·     Demonstração e Prova de Valor : Realizar demonstrações de produto convincentes, articulando claramente o ROI (Retorno sobre Investimento) e o valor da nossa solução para as necessidades específicas do cliente.

·     Metas : Alcançar e superar as metas (targets) de receita e novos negócios estabelecidas para o segmento Enterprise.

2.       Estratégia Go-to-Market (GTM) e Feedback de Produto (20% do Tempo)

·     Validação de PMF : Conduzir ou participar de entrevistas e sessões de feedback aprofundadas com prospects e clientes para identificar pain points e necessidades de mercado não atendidas.

·     Nos ajudar a determinar Unique Selling Propositions (USPs) .

·     Roadmap de Produto: Atuar como a voz do cliente Enterprise internamente, transformando o feedback coletado em requisitos de produto claros e priorizados para o time de Desenvolvimento/Produto.

·     Posicionamento: Testar e refinar continuamente nossa mensagem de GTM, proposta de valor e pricing para maximizar a conversão no mercado Enterprise.

Requisitos e Qualificações

Essenciais:

  • Experiência comprovada em Vendas B2B , preferencialmente no segmento da saúde .
  • Habilidade excepcional de comunicação , negociação e apresentação para executivos.
  • Personalidade proativa , dinâmica , que gosta de apreender e de trabalhar em ambientes complexos e desafiadores .

Diferenciais:

  • Entendimento e experiência prática em modelos SaaS, e com o conceito de Product-Market Fit (PMF) e ciclos de feedback de produto.
  • Fluência ou bom conhecimento de Inglês é recomendado
  • Conhecimento e uso prático de CRM .
  • Experiência em startups, ambientes de alta velocidade ou empresas SaaS (Software as a Service).

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
QAT Global – 100% Remote (Brazil Only – CLT hire)

QAT Global, a US-based IT consulting firm with over 30 years of experience, is seeking highly-skilled Java Full-Stack Developers with strong English communication skills to join our global engineering team. You will collaborate directly with our US-based customer and work with distributed development teams across the US, Costa Rica, and Brazil.


About the Role


As a Java Full-Stack Developer, you will be responsible for building mission-critical backend services and front-end components that support a large-scale financial platform. You will work across domains involving profiles, billing, ledger, invoicing, and payment flows, contributing to both core business logic and customer-facing UI experiences.

This role requires strong expertise in modern full-stack engineering combined with practical experience using AI-assisted development workflows , LLMs, and prompt engineering to accelerate delivery while maintaining high quality.


Responsibilities


  • Develop and maintain backend services across key financial modules (Profile, Billing, Ledger, Invoice, Recurring, Receipt, Remittance).
  • Build and enhance front-end components used in the Administration UI and Payment Widget.
  • Implement business logic, domain models, API endpoints, and cross-service integrations.
  • Work with frameworks defined by the architecture team (likely Java/Kotlin on the backend, TypeScript/React on the frontend).
  • Collaborate closely with QA engineers to ensure functional completeness and application stability.
  • Use AI-assisted workflows to generate code, improve documentation, and create automated tests.
  • Participate in agile ceremonies and work effectively with distributed teams.


Required Experience


  • Strong hands-on experience with Java (Spring Boot) , Node.js , and React .
  • Experience with PostgreSQL and relational data modeling.
  • Familiarity with Security / DevOps / Cloud practices.
  • Knowledge of GitHub CI/CD pipelines , versioning, and workflow automation.
  • Practical usage of GitHub Advanced Security (CodeQL, secret scanning, dependency checks).
  • Experience with AWS IAM (roles, policies, permission boundaries).
  • Experience deploying or maintaining workloads on EC2 , RDS , and SQS .
  • Working knowledge of LLM capabilities applied to software development (code generation, code review, refactoring, writing automated tests, requirement analysis).
  • Experience with Claude Sonnet 4.5 or willingness to learn quickly.
  • Ability to apply prompt engineering techniques to:
  • debug and reason about code
  • generate high-quality and consistent implementations
  • enforce architectural patterns and constraints
  • interpret technical and business requirements
  • Understanding of safe and responsible AI usage, including hallucination mitigation, validation steps, and code verification.
  • Basic familiarity with AI-powered IDEs (Cursor, GitHub Copilot, JetBrains AI Assistant, etc.).

title: Delivery Coordinator
description:
Sobre a posição

Estamos em busca de um(a) Delivery Coordinator para liderar a execução de projetos de implantação de soluções AWS em clientes dos EUA. A posição exige experiência sólida em gestão de projetos de escopo fechado e híbrido, além de forte habilidade de comunicação em inglês (nível C1), para interação com stakeholders internacionais.


Responsabilidades

  • Gerenciar projetos complexos de curta duração (em média 3 meses), incluindo assessments, POCs e MVPs.
  • Conduzir implantações de projetos AWS em clientes dos EUA.
  • Liderar equipes multidisciplinares, garantindo alinhamento, motivação e produtividade.
  • Acompanhar e controlar cronogramas, escopo, riscos e entregas.
  • Realizar acompanhamento e controle financeiro dos projetos, garantindo saúde orçamentária e rentabilidade.
  • Manter relacionamento próximo com stakeholders e clientes, assegurando qualidade e satisfação nas entregas.
  • Aplicar práticas de gestão de projetos (de preferência com certificação PMP).


Requisitos

  • Inglês fluente (nível C1) – imprescindível.
  • Experiência comprovada na gestão de projetos complexos, preferencialmente de tecnologia e cloud.
  • Vivência em projetos de implantação de soluções AWS é um diferencial relevante.
  • Experiência em gestão de equipes e coordenação de recursos.
  • Conhecimento em metodologias de projetos híbridas (ágil e waterfall).
  • Certificação PMP (desejável).
  • Forte capacidade de organização, comunicação e resolução de problemas.


Diferenciais

  • Experiência prévia em consultorias de tecnologia.
  • Atuação prévia em projetos internacionais.

title: Operations Analytics
description:
We're looking for a Operations Analytics 100% remote in Brazil


Location: Remote

Employment Type: Full-time


About the Role:

We are seeking an experienced Operations Analytics professional to deliver high-impact insights that support our end-to-end operations. In this role, you will work closely with teams across inventory, logistics, retail, and customer service, while partnering with technology and finance stakeholders. You’ll engage with nearly all aspects of a growing business to measure performance, identify opportunities, and drive alignment toward the most impactful operational improvements.

What You’ll Do

  • Analyze, understand, and quantify key operational efficiency metrics.
  • Design, implement, and report on item-level data throughout receiving, authentication, launch, and outbound workflows.
  • Provide daily reporting and product-health measurements to support business decision-making.
  • Communicate insights clearly and effectively to partner teams and leadership.
  • Collaborate with operations analysts to optimize processes and uncover opportunities for growth.


Minimum Requirements:

  • 5+ years of analytics experience.
  • Expert-level proficiency in SQL.
  • 5+ years working with BI tools such as MicroStrategy, Tableau, Looker, etc.
  • Strong ability to translate practical business problems into technical solutions.
  • Proven experience delivering time-sensitive strategic projects involving methodology development, analysis, recommendations, and executive presentation.
  • Demonstrated ability to thrive in ambiguous environments.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience in eCommerce or logistics industries.

title: Proprietário do produto
description:
DESCRIÇÃO 

Como Product Owner, você será responsável por conduzir processos de descoberta, ideação e validação das funcionalidades do produto, transformando necessidades em soluções claras e priorizadas. Atuará diretamente com o time de desenvolvimento, garantindo a evolução contínua do produto, alinhamento com stakeholders e entrega de valor aos usuários. 


RESPONSABILIDADES 


  • Entendimento dos requisitos/necessidades das áreas de negócio; 
  • Priorizar e manter o backlog de desenvolvimento de forma a otimizar a execução das tarefas e os incrementos no produto; 
  • Acompanhar cronogramas e roadmaps, alinhado à expectativa dos clientes e usuários; 
  • Definir KPIs/OKRs específicos de produtos entregues e comunicar o monitoramento regular aos stakeholders; 
  • Trabalhar com o líder técnico para entender quais as entregas técnicas necessárias; 
  • Definir incrementos de valor na plataforma; 
  • Conduzir as demandas desde a sua identificação e planejamento até a sua efetiva aplicação; 
  • Escrever os requisitos de desenvolvimento e definir seus critérios de aceitação junto com o time; 
  • Orientar o time de desenvolvimento na execução e entrega das demandas, sempre buscando o alinhamento com o negócio e o produto; 
  • Participar de demonstrações do produto;  
  • Validar sistemas e soluções entregues pelo time desenvolvimento; 
  • Atuar junto com o líder técnico, identificando possíveis atrasos nas entregas e definindo mudanças de prioridades; 
  • Manter-se em constante atualização com as melhores práticas do mercado, trazendo sugestões e novas soluções. 

REQUISITOS 


  • Experiência no desenvolvimento de produtos B2C; 
  • Experiência na escrita de requisitos de desenvolvimento de software; 
  • Experiência na gestão de backlog de desenvolvimento; 
  • Conhecimentos de técnicas de priorização do product backlog; 
  • Familiaridade com processos de discovery; 
  • Vivência em times de desenvolvimento ágil; 
  • Habilidade de negociação e relacionamento com desenvolvedores, usuários e partes interessadas; 
  • Background técnico na área de programação; 
  • Conhecimentos em Figma ou ferramentas similares; 


DIFERENCIAIS 


  • Experiência no desenvolvimento de soluções para maquininhas de pagamento; 
  • Experiência no desenvolvimento de soluções comerciais para o varejo e/ou marketplace; 
  • Conhecimento básicos de UX e UI; 
  • Certificação Product Owner (PSPO ou CSP);

title: Data Engineer
description:
Job Title: Data Engineer

Location: Remote (Brazil)

Employment Type: Full Time

Compensation: Competitive hourly rate, commensurate with experience



About Design Manager

Design Manager (+DesignSpec) is a leading provider of project management and accounting software tailored specifically for interior design firms. For over 30 years, we’ve helped thousands of designers run more efficient, profitable businesses with our cloud-based platform that integrates purchasing, budgeting, time tracking, and client communication in one seamless solution. As we grow, we're investing heavily in our data infrastructure to enhance product capabilities and improve client outcomes.



About the Role


We’re seeking a skilled Data Engineer to support our product and technology team. In this role, you’ll be responsible for building and maintaining data pipelines, analyzing data, and enabling data-driven decision-making across the organization. You'll be the first and only dedicated data analytics team member , so we’re looking for someone with an entrepreneurial mindset who is comfortable operating independently, defining structure, and solving complex data challenges.



What You’ll Do

  • Design, build, and maintain scalable data pipelines and ETL processes


  • Clean, validate, and structure raw data from various sources to ensure data quality and usability


  • Analyze large datasets to identify trends, patterns, and actionable insights that support business decision-making


  • Build and maintain dashboards, reports, and visualizations to communicate key performance metrics to stakeholders


  • Work cross-functionally with teams (e.g., finance, operations, marketing) to define data needs and solve business problems using data


  • Collaborate with engineering and product teams to understand and meet data requirements


  • Develop data models and schemas for analytics and reporting


  • Monitor, troubleshoot, and optimize data pipelines for performance and reliability


  • Support the design and implementation of a modern data warehouse architecture


  • Ensure data quality, governance, and security best practices are followed


  • Work with third-party APIs and internal tools to extract, transform, and load data


  • Demonstrate an entrepreneurial, self-starter attitude as the inaugural data analytics hire




Qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience in data engineering or a related field


  • Proficiency in SQL and experience with Python or another scripting language


  • Experience analyzing large datasets and generating insights that drive business impact


  • Familiarity with dashboarding and analytics platforms such as Mode, Power BI, or similar


  • Hands-on experience with modern data platforms (e.g., Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift)


  • Experience with ETL tools (e.g., Airflow, dbt, Fivetran) and data pipeline orchestration


  • Strong understanding of data warehousing concepts and data modeling


  • Excellent problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills


  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment with minimal oversight




Nice to Have


  • Experience in SaaS or B2B software environments


  • Exposure to finance or accounting domains




Why Join Us

  • Competitive hourly compensation


  • High-impact role with significant autonomy and visibility


  • Opportunity to shape the foundation of data and analytics at a growing SaaS company


  • Collaborative and mission-driven team environment


  • Possibility for contract extension or full-time conversion based on performance and business needs

For over 30 years, we’ve helped thousands of designers run more efficient, profitable businesses with our cloud-based platform that integrates purchasing, budgeting, time tracking, and client communication in one seamless solution. As we grow, we're investing heavily in our data infrastructure to enhance product capabilities and improve client outcomes.



About the Role


We’re seeking a skilled Data Engineer to support our product and technology team. In this role, you’ll be responsible for building and maintaining data pipelines, analyzing data, and enabling data-driven decision-making across the organization. You'll be the first and only dedicated data analytics team member , so we’re looking for someone with an entrepreneurial mindset who is comfortable operating independently, defining structure, and solving complex data challenges.



What You’ll Do

  • Design, build, and maintain scalable data pipelines and ETL processes


  • Clean, validate, and structure raw data from various sources to ensure data quality and usability


  • Analyze large datasets to identify trends, patterns, and actionable insights that support business decision-making


  • Build and maintain dashboards, reports, and visualizations to communicate key performance metrics to stakeholders


  • Work cross-functionally with teams (e.g., finance, operations, marketing) to define data needs and solve business problems using data


  • Collaborate with engineering and product teams to understand and meet data requirements


  • Develop data models and schemas for analytics and reporting


  • Monitor, troubleshoot, and optimize data pipelines for performance and reliability


  • Support the design and implementation of a modern data warehouse architecture


  • Ensure data quality, governance, and security best practices are followed


  • Work with third-party APIs and internal tools to extract, transform, and load data


  • Demonstrate an entrepreneurial, self-starter attitude as the inaugural data analytics hire




Qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience in data engineering or a related field


  • Proficiency in SQL and experience with Python or another scripting language


  • Experience analyzing large datasets and generating insights that drive business impact


  • Familiarity with dashboarding and analytics platforms such as Mode, Power BI, or similar


  • Hands-on experience with modern data platforms (e.g., Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift)


  • Experience with ETL tools (e.g., Airflow, dbt, Fivetran) and data pipeline orchestration


  • Strong understanding of data warehousing concepts and data modeling


  • Excellent problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills


  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment with minimal oversight




Nice to Have


  • Experience in SaaS or B2B software environments


  • Exposure to finance or accounting domains

  • Competitive hourly compensation
